title: Microsoft Teams Meetings, Webinars & Policy Configuration
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (enterprise Microsoft 365 Teams administration).

MicrosoftTeams PowerShell and the M365 admin center authored at exact detail from Microsoft public docs; plan-/version-dependent behavior (licensing/plan tiers, Premium features, Commercial vs Government cloud URLs like *.office365.us) cited or flagged 'verify in your tenant', never invented. Third-party devices/apps/tools at the pattern level. Automation is PowerShell — no hardcoded credentials or secrets in code. No client names. Compliance/legal determinations (records schedules, legal holds, info-barrier policy) deferred to compliance/legal.
hook: Configure Teams meetings and webinars for a secure, consistent experience
problem: Default meeting settings leave lobby, recording, and external-join controls inconsistent — a security and experience gap. This solution configures Teams meetings and webinars: meeting policies (lobby, recording/transcription, presenter roles), live events/webinars/town halls, meeting templates and sensitivity, and policy assignment by group — so meetings are secure, consistent, and fit-for-purpose.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the meeting model: meeting policies, webinars/town halls, templates + sensitivity, recording/transcription, and policy assignment.
Requirements Guide — prerequisites with how to verify/implement (Teams licensing incl. Premium where used, admin roles, groups, compliance stance).

Implementation Guide — design + apply meeting policies, configure webinars/town halls, build meeting templates + sensitivity, set recording/transcription policy, and assign by group — pilot-first, each policy named.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic MicrosoftTeams PowerShell / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Validation gates (policies applied by group, lobby/recording correct) plus Best Practices for consistent, secure meetings.
short: Configure Teams meetings & webinars — meeting policies (lobby/recording/roles), webinars/town halls, templates + sensitivity, and group-based assignment — so meetings are secure and consistent. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
